reason: V3-06 repair. Four must-fix findings from the previous cycle remain unfixed: (1) sync pipeline is wired only into the in-memory (test) path — the production SQLite path still buffers applyDeltas into sync_records without materializing into business tables and never records dirty records for pushDeltas; even in-memory, persistent_tasks/members/memberships/households writes never record dirty records; (2) applyDeltas is not transactional — cursor advances before materialization, so a materialization failure leaves data silently lost; (3) tenant isolation and balance-integrity rules (requireHouseholdMembership/requireRole/assertLedgerWrite) still have zero callers in the data-access path; (4) conflict resolution is incomplete: households are blind-overwritten, local revisions are fabricated as 0 so remote always wins, and SQLite applyDeltas remains blind INSERT OR REPLACE. The WIP baseline must be preserved and the next cycle must repair these four findings on the existing candidate.
